fact: The e-Sénégal single-window app, launched 24 March 2026 and built by SENUM SA, gives access through authentication on the NIN carried on the biometric identity card, with judicial-record, nationality-certificate and similar procedures live at launch.

IPRES, the pension institution, opened its three-month periodic proof-of-life campaign on 1 July 2026 on the Maa ngi nii platform, where Senegalese pensioners must hold their ECOWAS national identity card to complete the proof of life.

Article 2 of decree 2016-1536 makes the ECOWAS biometric identity card serve as the voter card for citizens on the electoral rolls, with the elector number and polling place printed on it beside the NIN.
